title: Purchase a one-year market data subscription for Research
decision: Approve a 480 USD annual plan for the on-chain analytics API used by research.paid-source, charged to the company card today, so Research stops hitting the free-tier limit.
goal: Unblock the competitor and market scans in strategy objective 3, which have been rate-limited for two weeks.
alternatives_rejected: Monthly plan at 45 USD (same yearly total, more admin)
Scrape public dashboards instead (fragile, against the provider's terms)
expected_cost: 480 USD once; covered by the paid-data envelope over the year
rollback_plan: Cancel the subscription within the provider's 14-day refund window if the data proves unnecessary; the cancellation link is in the provider's billing portal.
why_now: Three research tickets are blocked on rate limits and the CEO cycle keeps re-queuing them.
risk: Low: the subscription is a known provider already used on the free tier.
reversibility: Refundable for 14 days, then sunk cost for the remainder of the year.
evidence: tickets RES-12, RES-14, RES-15 blocked with note 'free tier exhausted'
paid-data envelope usage this month: 0 of 30 USD
